name: Drevsin Matcha-Pomegranate Sour Ribbons
description: Flat synth-gelatin ribbons dusted in citric-pomegranate crystal, with a grassy matcha base that cuts through the sour coating in the final chew. Sold in folded paper sleeves of eight.
flavor_profile: Sharp pomegranate sour opening, bitter-green matcha body, mild sweetness on the finish
slogan: Bitter first. Sweet if you earn it.
cultural_context: Popular among Tier 2 students and shift workers who prefer sour candy that doesn't collapse into pure sweetness. Drevsin's paper sleeve packaging is collectible — each run has a different stamped pattern, and trading sleeves is a minor subculture in transit hub common areas.
story_hooks: A limited run of Drevsin sleeves was printed with a partial city infrastructure map hidden in the geometric pattern — no one knows if it was intentional.
The Collective's matcha supply comes from a single vertical farm whose operator has gone missing, leaving the next production run in jeopardy.
A Tier 3 kid becomes obsessed with completing a full set of Drevsin sleeve patterns and traces one rare print to a defunct distribution node deep in a contested Shelf district.
